title: Objective-to-Delivery Traceability Ledger and Rapid Reprioritization Protocol
creator: Asha Kumar
description: Create a lightweight, auditable ledger that maps company-level objectives to active initiatives, with a companion rapid reprioritization protocol. The ledger will be a canonical cross-functional reference used by PM, Eng, and Design to: 1) verify initiative alignment to objectives; 2) surface drift (scope or metric divergence) within one sprint; 3) trigger a 48-hour reprioritization path when a critical dependency or market signal appears. Deliverables: ledger schema, initiative ready-state checklist, escalation matrix, and a one-page playbook for Q2 leadership reviews.

acceptance_criteria: Canonical ledger exists as a CSV and living Confluence page with columns: objective_id, initiative_key, owner, success_metric, baseline, target, cadence, ready_state, rag, last_updated
Three pilot initiatives have complete rows with validated success metrics (Growth onboarding funnel, Runtime batching TTFB, Console rollout adoption)
Escalation matrix defines roles, 48-hour decision SLA, fallback owners, and budget holdback thresholds
Automated telemetry integration plan is documented for two success metrics (ENG-41234) and owner assigned
Playbook one-pager created for Q2 leadership review and circulated to heads of Eng, Product, Design, and Finance
next_steps: 2026-03-13: Engineering to scope telemetry ingestion work (ENG-41234)
2026-03-15: Finance to define budget holdback bands and thresholds
2026-03-16: Run pilot ledger update with Growth PM and Console PM in weekly ops sync

decisions: Ledger will be CSV-first to lower friction for export/import; Confluence will host canonical copy
Reprioritization SLA set to 48 hours for high-impact triggers; 5 business days for medium-impact
Budget holdbacks will be defined as percentage slices (to be provided by Finance) and tied to reprioritization triggers
